name: @pipeworx/mcp-libretranslate

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text. Source can be "auto" to auto-detect. Returns translated text and the detected source (if applicable).

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the source language of a piece of text. Returns ranked language candidates with confidence.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List languages supported by the configured LibreTranslate instance.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-libretranslate forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the libretranslate pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
